extracted.name: Mayonnaise Biscuits
extracted.description: Mayonnaise biscuits are a Southern tradition. Made with just self-rising flour, milk, and mayo, they're light, fluffy, and absolutely delicious!
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Stir flour, milk, and mayonnaise together in a large bowl until just blended. Drop 12 spoonfuls dough onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 12 minutes.
